v0.1.2.description:
Sly 3 Archipelago implementation. For setup instructions, check out the [README](https://github.com/NikolajDanger/APSly3/blob/main/README.md).

## Changes
### Bug fixes and improvements
- Fixed problem where receiving the trigger bomb item breaks everything.
- Fixed a problem where receiving the hover pack item makes Bentley able to jump less.
- Fixed a problem where a misreading causes the client to allocate an array with billions of elements.
- Several logic fixes.

v0.2.0.description:
Sly 3 Archipelago implementation. For setup instructions, check out the [README](https://github.com/NikolajDanger/APSly3/blob/main/README.md).

## Changes
### Features
- Added dialogue skip (hold all four shoulder buttons).

### Bug fixes and improvements
- Several stability fixes. Checkpoint toggling has been disabled, since that was causing the vast majority of problems. It will return in a future update.
- Fixed resuming for episode 6.
- Several logic fixes.
- Made Hover Pack and Grapple Cam progressive items.
